{{Otheruses|Master}}
A '''master''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] considered to be highly skilled in their particular field. There were many masters in Gree society, and they were respected by the populace as they had the skills and knowledge to operate and maintain [[Gree technology]].
